args.body: Hi Dora! I visited your personal website. It's clean and simple, and your contact email is easy to find. To improve it, you could add more about yourself, such as your projects, interests or background, plus some visuals to make it more engaging. Nice work!

Hi Eve! I enjoyed visiting your blog. Your mention of hiking as your favorite hobby gives it a personal touch. To improve it, you could add posts about your hiking trips, with photos, favorite trails and tips, and maybe a way for readers to contact you or subscribe. Great start!

final_text:
